directionA:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity original Lantern fantasy action RPG UI concept board, preview only.
Create TWO full desktop-browser screens on one tall concept board: Title above, Adventures below. Each screen is exactly 16:10 in proportion, imagined at 1280x800. Clear horizontal separation; no device mockup, external annotations, captions or outer presentation frame.
Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL OWNED Lantern loading lantern illustration, supplied as an art reference and reusable focal artwork. It is not licensed art. Faithfully preserve its forged-black-iron silhouette, worn brass joins, amber smoky glass and quiet candle warmth; do not create alternate lanterns.
Identity: Lantern's existing warm crafted fantasy interface. Restrained iron and worn brass, charcoal reading surfaces (#171411, #24201B, #100E0C), warm ivory (#F0E6D2), secondary beige (#BEB19A), brass (#C7A36A), amber primary action (#E7AC65). Short headings resemble locally served Pirata One blackletter; normal labels and values use clean readable system sans serif. Deliberate sparse ornament. No broad glow, neon, parchment, green fantasy gradients or excessive filigree.
TOP SCREEN exact content: a heading "Lantern", the reference lantern, a primary "Adventures" control and a secondary "Options" control. These are the only visible words. No Continue on Title, no tagline, no Quit button, no footer instructions.
BOTTOM SCREEN exact content: heading "Adventures" and a quiet "Back" control. Four rows on the LEFT with slot numbers in small secondary type and names or empty state:
"1" "Adventure 1" (selected)
"2" "Mira"
"3" "Empty"
"4" "Empty"
Show exactly four rows, no portraits, character models, class, level, XP, playtime, coins, timestamp, location thumbnail or extra invented stats.
Selected adventure details on the RIGHT: heading "Adventure 1"; small secondary label "Campfire"; value "Homestead"; warm amber primary button "Continue"; quieter clearly separate secondary action "Delete". Do not place actions on every row. Selected row has a restrained brass edge and tiny warm selection marker. Provide generous quiet space and a stable hierarchy rather than filling it with decorations.
No save indicators, warnings, recovery notices, storage language or implementation details. No forests, licensed gameplay renders or live world backdrop. This is a composed UI mockup; all text legible and accurately spelled, hit areas comfortably at least 44px at imagined 1280x800.
Direction A — CENTERED AND CONTAINED. Title screen has a modest 220px-tall lantern centered above the centered Lantern heading; two vertically stacked centered buttons below. The Adventures screen has a centered unified forged-iron menu sheet about 920px wide and 440px tall. Its header contains Adventures left and Back right; below, four equal-height selectable rows occupy the left 40 percent and the details occupy the right 60 percent separated by one quiet vertical brass rule. Small sparse crafted corner joins and subtle inset depth, not a huge decorative art frame. The selected primary button sits naturally under the campfire detail; Delete rests farther below as a quiet secondary action. Lantern artwork is only on the Title screen.
dialogs:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: original Lantern UI naming and deletion interaction storyboard, high fidelity concept only.
Input image 1 is the freshly generated ORIGINAL Lantern centered Title/Adventures concept board. Use its LOWER screen as a style and layout reference only. No licensed assets or gameplay renders are supplied.
Produce one tall concept board containing TWO complete 16:10 desktop UI screenshots stacked vertically. Each represents 1280x800. A thin quiet line separates the screens. No explanatory labels outside the UI, no device frame.
Keep the chosen UI identity: warm charcoal #171411, restrained inset blackened-iron surfaces, small worn brass corner details, ivory #F0E6D2, beige #BEB19A, warm amber primary emphasis, subtle material texture. Avoid oversized forged frames. Headings should evoke the narrow readable Pirata One face, not extravagant Old English lettering. ALL buttons, input contents, row names and body copy are clear SYSTEM SANS SERIF, never blackletter. Reuse the reference's four-row-left selected-details-right Adventures screen behind each modal, darkened by a uniform modal scrim without blur, with background text faint but still sufficient to identify the selected slot. No lantern or scenery in these two screenshots.
TOP: selected slot 3 is empty in the background. Underlying rows exactly "1 Adventure 1", "2 Mira", "3 Empty", "4 Empty"; selected row 3 subtly indicated. Center a compact 480px-wide naming dialog, quiet solid opaque charcoal, finely crafted understated brass edges. Heading exactly "New Adventure". Label exactly "Name". One visibly editable text field containing exactly "Rowan", with a slim warm-ivory focus outline indicating focus on the field. Footer buttons: "Cancel" and "Begin Adventure". Begin Adventure is the primary warm amber accent control. Leave comfortable breathing room; no helper paragraphs, class choices, portraits, counters, placeholder lore or extra steps. At intended scale the text field and buttons are at least 44px high.
BOTTOM: selected occupied slot 1 in the background. Same four rows with row 1 selected, same understated Adventures screen. Center a compact 480px-wide deletion confirmation dialog. Heading exactly "Delete Adventure 1?". Body exactly "This removes all progress for this adventure." Footer buttons exactly "Cancel" and "Delete". CANCEL is visibly focused with a clear thin warm-ivory keyboard focus ring. Delete uses muted coral lettering and a restrained dark surface, not a bright red or gold primary fill. No typed-name input, skull icons, warning triangles or extra instructions. Make name and consequence clearly legible.
These are state explorations for the SAME screen family, not different artistic themes. Accurate spelling, clear visual separation, uncluttered layout, strong reading hierarchy. No save-related issues or indicators, no warnings about storage, no invented gameplay stats, no scenery, no logos or watermark.
revision:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: revised original Lantern UI concept board, preview only.
Edit the supplied original Option A concept board. Change ONLY the two visible occurrences of the exact word "Adventures" to the exact word "Play": the primary button in the top Title screen and the heading at the upper left of the bottom slot-selection screen.
Keep all other content, text, layout, scale, colors, lighting, lantern artwork, background, materials, borders, frames and selection states unchanged. Preserve "Lantern", "Options", "Back", "Adventure 1", "Mira", "Empty", "Campfire", "Homestead", "Continue", "Delete", and all four slot numbers exactly. The adventure names remain unchanged.
Render "Play" with the same existing typographic treatment as each respective replaced label. Keep the button's existing size and center its new shorter label; keep the lower heading left-aligned in its original position. No additional words, controls, embellishments or scenery.
